_note: Slot spine v2 (canon 2026-10-17, rolled out here 2026-11-22): 1 hero in light mode, 2-3 the top ASO features (sharing a list, which the name and subtitle sell; your usuals and recent items in the Add sheet, seeded by qaAccount()), 4 the Josh Approved card, then Kits, an accessibility showcase (large text: capture.mjs --font-scale 1.3 --cell store-<store>-large-text) and the dark-mode shot last (--appearance dark --cell store-<store>-dark). Captions are benefits, not labels, 8 words max. The home screen shot was dropped: with one seeded list it sold nothing. Android tablet (7"/10") screenshots intentionally omitted: the app is portrait-locked (app.json orientation), so tablet shots could only upscale the phone layout and Play shows the phone set to tablet users.
